expectedValueEncoding: Success projections inherit draftDefaults and eventDefaults. A case may name a chord by symbol-cases.json case ID instead of duplicating its handwritten AST. SourceText always equals case input. Repeat, annotation, and explicit-duration cases override every affected event default. Boundary expectedEvidence objects and delegatedEvidenceProjections are exact named-field projections; omitted evidence counters remain governed by the independent invariants in t0-syntax-contract.json. Every one-path formatter mutation row, including a first-excess boundary ownership fault, carries a stable id and one exact mutationProjection object with path, before, and after values. Explicit empty annotations decode to the same semantic empty value as absence; event annotationRange retains written syntax until canonical formatting intentionally omits it.

draftDefaults.headers: document uses parsed values; fragment copies request.meter and leaves every other header null

rangePolicy: All written ranges are manually counted zero-based half-open UTF-16 offsets. Boundary recipes declare exact counts instead of embedding enormous sources.
